title: Funds management: Compliance and oversight
subject: This guide addresses the compliance and oversight obligations of responsible entities of registered managed investment schemes, corporate directors of retail corporate collective investment vehicles (CCIVs), and Australian passport fund operators under the Corporations Act and other legal obligations.
background: The guide is issued under ASIC's administration of the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) and related legislation. It is intended for responsible entities, corporate directors of retail CCIVs, and Australian passport fund operators, with parts also relevant to wholesale scheme operators, IDPS operators, MDA providers, and oversight bodies such as compliance committees and auditors.
ruling: ASIC expects responsible entities and corporate directors to maintain a robust compliance management system that is integrated into their business operations and risk management framework. The guide sets out ASIC's interpretation of the statutory obligations under the Corporations Act, including the requirement to have a compliance plan, to monitor and enforce compliance with the plan, and to ensure adequate oversight by compliance committees or independent oversight entities. ASIC provides practical guidance on the content of compliance plans, the role and independence of compliance committees, and the annual review process. The guide also addresses specific obligations for Australian passport fund operators under the Corporations (Passport) Rules 2018. ASIC states that it will take into account whether an entity has implemented an effective compliance management system when considering enforcement action.
